# HELMET brand files

**The mark is generated by ChatGPT, not drawn by hand:** an American football helmet in side profile,
facing right, with a gold face cage, on a Wayne State green `#0C5449` rounded tile. The shell is cream
`#F4F1EA`, the cage is Wayne State gold `#FFCC33`. Berry `#8B2145` is a site accent only and never
appears in the mark.

## Files
| File | Size | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `helmet-avatar-1024.png` | 1024 × 1024 | The master tile: GitLab project avatar, Open Graph image, slides and documents |
| `helmet-avatar-512.png` | 512 × 512 | Hero and header mark at large sizes |
| `helmet-avatar-256.png` | 256 × 256 | Header and hero mark, displayed at 2× or less of its CSS size; the `apple-touch-icon` |
| `favicon-64.png` | 64 × 64 | Favicon for high-resolution contexts |
| `favicon-32.png` | 32 × 32 | Favicon |
| `favicon-16.png` | 16 × 16 | Favicon |
| `favicon.ico` | 16, 32 and 48 px | The classic favicon; the `.ico` holds all three sizes |
| `helmet-board.png` | 3840 × 2680 | The brand board (below) |

The favicon links a page head carries:

```html
<link rel="icon" href="brand/favicon.ico" sizes="any">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="brand/favicon-32.png">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="16x16" href="brand/favicon-16.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="brand/helmet-avatar-256.png">
```

## The board
`helmet-board.png` is the identity sheet: hero mark, app icon, horizontal and stacked lockups, the mark
on light and on dark, the colour palette, typography, the favicons at 64/32/16, clear space and minimum
size (32 px digital), the do/don't, and a response-headers mockup. It is the reference for how the mark
sits next to the wordmark.

## Rule
The mark comes only from ChatGPT. Nobody redraws it, edits it, or "improves" it: no new geometry, no
recoloring, no shadows or effects. If a vector is ever needed, trace the PNG with vtracer or potrace —
tracing is allowed, redrawing is not. The rule has a name: The Shell Game. The shell stays, the cage
stays, the tile stays.
